scenes.title: A Sad Little Rabbit
scenes.body: One sunny morning, a small round bear was playing in a soft green meadow. Then he saw a tiny grey rabbit sitting all alone under a big oak tree. The rabbit's ears were droopy, and the rabbit looked very sad.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about empathy.

scenes.title: Asking What’s Wrong
scenes.body: The little bear walked over and sat down beside the rabbit. “Are you okay?” he asked gently. The rabbit sniffled and said, “I dropped all my berries, and now I have nothing to eat.” The little bear felt sad for his friend.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about empathy.

scenes.title: Sharing Together
scenes.body: The little bear smiled and opened his little basket. “I have plenty of berries,” he said. “We can share them, and then we can pick more together.” The rabbit’s eyes lit up with happiness.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about empathy.

scenes.title: New Friends, Full Hearts
scenes.body: They sat side by side and shared the sweet berries. Then they skipped through the meadow and picked even more. The rabbit was happy again, and the little bear was happy too. And from that day on, they always remembered to look out for each other.
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about empathy.
